discipline: dungeon-ml-zoo — five learners + memory-walker, one tournament in SuperInstance/quilt-dungeons. Claims sealed BEFORE the eval tournament runs; tournament.mjs verifies seal + battery fail-closed before stepping the engine.

battery.algorithm: sha256 over the exact file bytes bound at seal time; tournament.mjs re-derives and refuses to run on drift

claims.claim: ga-params (GA over the parametric baseline, pop 12 x 8 gens, fitness = MEAN SCORE ON EVAL SEEDS 101-108 — the mission-specified leak, disclosed) has mean eval score >= q-table mean eval score on the same eval seeds, in the official tournament receipts.
claims.refusal: FAIL means even a GA fitted directly on the eval seeds could not beat the 64-state tabular learner there — the strongest possible indictment of this GA parameterization; PASS must be read against the disclosed fitness leak (the GA saw these seeds during evolution, the q-table never did).

claims.claim: The contextual bandit script-selector (12 contexts: phase x hp-band; 5 arms trained on 100 pre-registered pulls over seeds 1-20) beats always-hunter script-choice: mean eval score on seeds 101-108 strictly >= hunter mean.
claims.refusal: FAIL means per-phase script switching added nothing over always-hunter at this context granularity and pull budget.

claims.claim: tiny-nn (2-layer MLP, behavioral cloning from q-table eval-seed trajectories + 3 online fine-tune episodes) outscores the random-policy reference on >= 7 of the 8 eval seeds.
claims.refusal: FAIL means the cloned MLP does not reliably clear a uniform random walker — BC from 8 trajectories did not transfer to a policy.

claims.claim: memory-walker (scripted spatial-memory frontier explorer, NOT a learner) reaches the exit (won=true) on >= 3 of the 8 eval seeds — the first exit wins anywhere in the fleet dungeon records (0/24 upstream baseline runs ever reached it).
claims.refusal: FAIL means exploration memory alone does not reach the exit within 200 turns on these maps often enough, and the 200-pt win bonus stays marginal for scripted agents; the exact win count is receipted either way.
